title: renovate: bump OpenLDAP once per month
body:
When a Git tag appears in the OpenLDAP GitHub repo mirror, and Renovate picks
it up (12 hours later in case of 2.7.2), the source tarball may not yet be
available at the download site. Do this once a month when the tag and upload
are likely synced up.

Also: revert to 2.7.1.

Follow-up to 9b170c39afcd28bd9510379d8d0cf47b0d079701 #23544
Follow-up to 30f5a2b5b8097eaa2941b504c761df445e8b006b #23266

files.patch:
@@ -59,7 +59,8 @@
     {
       "description": "Schedule package updates on the 10th of each month",
       "matchSourceUrls": [
-        "**/awslabs/**"
+        "**/awslabs/**",
+        "**/openldap/**"
       ],
       "groupName": "monthly updates by URL",
       "schedule": [

@@ -52,7 +52,7 @@ env:
   # renovate: datasource=github-tags depName=nghttp2/nghttp2
   NGHTTP2_VERSION: 1.70.0
   # renovate: datasource=github-tags depName=openldap/openldap versioning=regex:^(?<major>\d+)_(?<minor>\d+)_(?<patch>\d+)$ extractVersion=^OPENLDAP_REL_ENG_(?<version>.+)$
-  OPENLDAP_VERSION: 2_7_2
+  OPENLDAP_VERSION: 2_7_1
   # renovate: datasource=github-releases depName=openssl/openssl extractVersion=^openssl-(?<version>.+)$
   OPENSSL_VERSION: 4.0.3
   # renovate: datasource=github-tags depName=rustls/rustls-ffi
